title: Emet soul.yaml
description: The portable personality. Valid on any body. The engine MUST NOT write body-specific state here — no joint trims, no calibration, no device paths.

name.description: P0. What the robot is called. Free text — any name at all. Deliberately NOT the wake word.

wake_word.description: P0. Which pretrained wake word wakes this soul. Must be a member of the shipped set — membership is a semantic rule so that the set can grow without a schema change. A soul may be named Barnaby and answer to 'emet'.

line.description: P0. Which reference soul this derives from. Metadata only — the engine does not branch on it.

license.description: RSV. An SPDX licence identifier for souls published to the community registry — a soul is configuration but also prose, and a registry nobody can rely on legally is a registry nobody builds on. null is legal for a private soul.

summary.description: P0. The seed a human writes.

system_prompt.description: P0. Compiled from summary, or hand-written.

traits.description: P0. Numeric knobs the engine actually reads.

drift.description: RSV. Behaviour arrives in release Afflatus. Fields exist now so nothing migrates later. Constraint fixed today: drift must be auditable and reversible — deltas live in an append-only table keyed to the episode that caused them, and soul.yaml is never mutated.

interaction.description: P0. Turn-taking is what separates charming from infuriating, and no personality prompting fixes it.

patience_ms.description: Silence threshold before responding. Exposed as a persona knob so a thoughtful soul waits longer than an eager one.

barge_in.description: Requires audio.input.aec != none. Cross-document rule, checked when a bundle is paired with a manifest.

idle.description: P0 minimal, V1 full. A separate loop from conversation, at the lowest priority. On a body with no actuators it is a silent no-op.

proactivity.description: RSV. 0.0 = never initiates. Ignored in P0. The highest-risk feature in the product: a companion that talks unprompted is either magical or intolerable, and the difference is mostly frequency.

cross_person_disclosure.description: P0. Whether the robot may tell one person something it learned about another (levels 0 and 1). Default true, because it is what a companion who cared would do. Must be surfaced during setup in plain language, not buried.

consolidation.description: RSV. Nightly batch rewriting of profiles and episode summaries.

models.description: P0. BYOK — bring your own keys. Online-first: in P0 the robot fails loudly and in character when a key or the network is missing.

self_model_overrides.description: RSV. Lets a character describe its own body in its own voice, rather than in the engine's deterministic template phrasing.

key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the key. The key itself is never written into the bundle.
